pages.text: Five-headed serpent of the Stygian Marsh, 400 health. Its heads spit poison and its wounds close by themselves.
Weakness: fire. It stops the regeneration for 10 seconds and burns three times as hard. A fire aspect blade cuts 2.5 times as deep at level I and 4 times at II.
How to beat: fire aspect, flame arrows, lava. Beware of Karkinos nearby. Drops scales, emeralds, diamonds and a hydra egg.
